model.inference_mode: Set gp_layer.fitted=True BEFORE eval; inference mode; no dropout, AMP or TF32; SDPA enabled

model.selection_rule: three-seed mean scores; common epoch per budget; maximize 0.5*C3 reconciled-legacy concordance + 0.5*C3 added concordance
model.selection_tie_break: smaller positive budget, then earlier epoch; strict numeric ordering without a tolerance
